items.title: K_0 of the coherent sheaves set-theoretically supported on a closed subscheme is K_0 of the closed subscheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a closed subscheme Z of a locally Noetherian scheme X, the exact inclusion of the category of coherent sheaves on Z into the Serre subcategory of coherent sheaves on X whose set-theoretic support lies in Z induces an isomorphism on K_0 (statement lines 4049-4060, tag 0FDT). The proof constructs the inverse map explicitly by taking the graded pieces of the I-adic filtration of a module supported on Z, and then has to prove its additivity on short exact sequences, which it does by introducing a double filtration F^{p,q} = I^p F intersect I^q G and comparing three different ways of writing the same class. The double-filtration comparison is the substance, so the claim is H2.
